title: Notification regarding the Division Bench sitting on 27th July,2026.

KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 23'd July, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ It is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that:-
(i)
(ii)
Division Bench will sit at 12:00 noon on 27n1 July, 2026;
Single Bench matters of Hon'ble the Chief Justice to be listed on 27t[1 July, 2026
will be taken up on the same day before the Single Bench of Hon'bte Mr. Justice
A. Bimol Singh for fixing dates, extension of interim orders as well as for taking
up urgent hatters; and
(iii) From the week beginning Monday, the 27th July, 2026, there shall be a Special
Division Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh and Hon’bIe Mr. Justice A.
Guneshwar Sharma on every Thursday at 12:00 noon until further order.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. AIIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
